verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Agent Runtime, a fully managed auto-scaling Google Cloud service built for deploying ADK agents, and Cloud Run as a managed container platform. The GitHub README shows a one-command `adk deploy cloud_run`, and the docs say deployed agents can be "accessed, queried, and used in production." Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to invoke the deployed agent as an API endpoint (request format, auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the deploy-and-call flow.
